methodology: Leakage-safe GradientBoostingRegressor ensemble with a seasonal weighted baseline; trained offline, evaluated on held-out 2025 data, and never trained at request time.

mostCommonRiskTier.maeDefinition: Mean loss percentage within the most common training risk tier, used as that tier's numeric representative.

lastObservedLoss.maeDefinition: Absolute error from the pair's most recent observed loss percentage before the 2025 holdout.
